data.title: HSE Engineer
data.summary: Keep commissioning and live-site work safe without slowing the team down with paperwork theatre.
data.description: You will lead health, safety, and environment practice across project sites, working with engineers, contractors, and plant teams. We are looking for someone who can make risk visible and practical, not someone who owns a folder of forms.
responsibilities: Lead site risk assessments and method statements.
Coach engineers and contractors on safe work practice.
Investigate incidents and near misses with clear actions.
Maintain legal and client HSE requirements.
requirements: 5+ years in HSE within industrial or construction environments.
Knowledge of Thai HSE regulation and contractor management.
Strong field presence and calm communication.
